ruleToc.nextTocUrl:
<js>
var out = [];
var h = java.ajax(baseUrl);
var mA = /aid=(\d+)/.exec(baseUrl);
var aid = mA ? mA[1] : "";
var pc = /pagecheck=([0-9a-f]+)/.exec(h);
if (pc) {
  var re2 = /page=[0-9]+/g, maxp = 1, m;
  while ((m = re2.exec(h)) != null) { var v = parseInt(m[0].substring(5)); if (v > maxp) maxp = v; }
  for (var p = 2; p <= maxp; p++) out.push("https://m.wowenku.com/info.php?aid=" + aid + "&pagecheck=" + pc[1] + "&page=" + p);
}
out;
</js>
